generate_l2reg_sweep: generate a hypermodel sweep over l2 regularization parameters with weight decay values 0.1, 0.3, 1, 3, 10
generate_index_sweep: generate a hypermodel sweep over index dimension parameters with values 1, 3, 5, 7
generate_boot_sweep: generate a hypermodel sweep over bootstrap distribution types none, bernoulli, exponential
generate_prior_sweep: generate a hypermodel sweep over prior function parameters including scale, hidden sizes, and temperature scale
build_paper_agent: build a paper agent with default hypermodel config, constructor, and combined sweep of all parameter variations
